title: AtScale query lifecycle
description: Inbound Query, Planning, Outbound and Result Processing per AtScale query, from the AtScale query history. Sample code, provided as is, not supported by AtScale.

panels.title: Queries
panels.description: Queries that finished in the selected range (from the AtScale query history).

targets.expr: sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Average duration
panels.description: End-to-end server time per query: Inbound Query + Planning + Outbound + Result Processing.

targets.expr: sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_sum{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_bucket{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_bucket{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Served from aggregates or cache
panels.description: Share of queries AtScale answered from an aggregate table or the query cache.

targets.expr: sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",optimization!="none"}[$__range])) / sum(increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Exporter polling
panels.description: 1 = the last poll of every selected AtScale instance succeeded.

targets.expr: min(atscale_query_exporter_up{env=~"$env"})

panels.title: Average time per phase
panels.description: Average per query. Outbound is split into the time spent waiting before the warehouse call (connection pool, queueing, SQL generation) and the time the warehouse subqueries ran (parallel subqueries counted once).

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (phase) (increase(atscale_query_phase_duration_seconds_sum{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",phase=~"inbound|planning|outbound_wait|warehouse|result_processing"}[$__range])) / sum by (phase) (increase(atscale_query_phase_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",phase=~"inbound|planning|outbound_wait|warehouse|result_processing"}[$__range])), "phase", "Inbound Query", "phase", "inbound"), "phase", "Planning", "phase", "planning"), "phase", "Outbound: wait before warehouse", "phase", "outbound_wait"), "phase", "Outbound: warehouse", "phase", "warehouse"), "phase", "Result Processing", "phase", "result_processing"), "phase", "Outbound (total)", "phase", "outbound")

panels.title: Share of total query time
panels.description: Which phase consumes most of the summed server time in the range.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (phase) (increase(atscale_query_phase_duration_seconds_sum{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",phase=~"inbound|planning|outbound_wait|warehouse|result_processing"}[$__range])), "phase", "Inbound Query", "phase", "inbound"), "phase", "Planning", "phase", "planning"), "phase", "Outbound: wait before warehouse", "phase", "outbound_wait"), "phase", "Outbound: warehouse", "phase", "warehouse"), "phase", "Result Processing", "phase", "result_processing"), "phase", "Outbound (total)", "phase", "outbound")

panels.title: Which catalogs and models drive it
Catalogs and models, slowest first
panels.description: Per catalog and model. A high warehouse share with few aggregate hits points to missing aggregates; high planning points to model complexity; high outbound wait points to connection or queue limits.

targets.expr: sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_sum{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range])) / sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (catalog, model, le) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_bucket{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range])))

sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_phase_duration_seconds_sum{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",phase="planning"}[$__range])) / sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_phase_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",phase="planning"}[$__range]))

sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_phase_duration_seconds_sum{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",phase="outbound_wait"}[$__range])) / sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_phase_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",phase="outbound_wait"}[$__range]))

sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_phase_duration_seconds_sum{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",phase="warehouse"}[$__range])) / sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_phase_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",phase="warehouse"}[$__range]))

sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status",optimization!="none"}[$__range])) / sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_subqueries_sum{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range])) / sum by (catalog, model) (increase(atscale_query_subqueries_count{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Average time per phase by optimization
panels.description: AGGS = answered from an aggregate table, CACHE = query cache, none = raw tables. The warehouse bar shows what aggregates save.

panels.title: Query duration distribution
panels.description: How many queries fell into each duration bucket per interval. Bands far above the main cluster are the outliers to inspect in the AtScale Queries page.

targets.expr: sum by (le) (increase(atscale_query_duration_seconds_bucket{env=~"$env",query_type=~"$query_type",catalog=~"$catalog",model=~"$model",optimization=~"$optimization",status=~"$status"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Average JDBC connection borrow time by pool
panels.description: From the engine's Kamon/OpenTelemetry metrics on :9095. Most JDBC traffic is the AtScale system database, so use this only to check whether a pool wait explains a high outbound wait.

targets.expr: sum by (env, jdbc_pool_name) (rate(jdbc_pool_borrow_time_seconds_sum{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (env, jdbc_pool_name) (rate(jdbc_pool_borrow_time_seconds_count{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: JDBC borrow timeouts and statements in flight
panels.description: Borrow timeouts > 0 mean queries waited for a free connection and gave up.

targets.expr: sum by (env) (increase(jdbc_pool_borrow_timeouts_total{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (env) (rate(jdbc_statements_in_flight_sum{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (env) (rate(jdbc_statements_in_flight_count{env=~"$env"}[$__rate_interval]))
